The depot was Southgate, and I've replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

- **Where that comes from:** On 2025-09-03, Priyanka posted in that channel that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots. She said Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. When she closed the incident at 18:43, she said Southgate had cleared the backlog.
- **What I couldn't find:** The channel doesn't give Southgate's address or any other site details, and there are no shared files on Tansley Parcel. If Tobias needs the full address, he'll have to get it from Priyanka or from the customer.

I only used the incident channel and public files, all of which Tobias can see himself.
